summary: Verified checkout required-field validation (name/phone/email) end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_checkout_validation.py — 6/6 pytest cases pass. POST /api/orders returns 400 for customer_phone='123', customer_email='' , customer_email='abc', empty customer_name; and returns 200 with an order id for the valid payload (name/phone 6900000000/email cantopizza1@gmail.com). Frontend guest flow: added Μαργαρίτα, went to /checkout, chose pickup — missing-fields-note visible and lists 'όνομα, τηλέφωνο, email'; submit-order-btn while empty triggers toast 'Συμπλήρωσε το όνομά σου' and phone-error 'Απαιτείται έγκυρο τηλέφωνο (10 ψηφία)' inline; filling name+phone=6912345678 with email 'abc' shows email-error 'Απαιτείται έγκυρο email'; entering cantopizza1@gmail.com hides the note and turns the submit button bg-brand; submit creates the order and lands on /order/{id} (order id f6d87d9e-eaa3-414e-a6eb-9027d35629b1 — cancelled during teardown). Admin flow (cantopizza1@gmail.com / Telecanto2026!): /checkout shows the three labelled required fields ('Όνομα *', 'Τηλέφωνο *', 'Email *') and they are editable; clearing phone re-shows the missing-fields-note listing 'τηλέφωνο, email'. Note: after logging in and immediately navigating add-product → /checkout the fields rendered EMPTY instead of prefilled with the admin's profile (Telecanto Admin / 24210 55085 / cantopizza1@gmail.com). Root cause: Checkout.jsx initializes `form` via useState only on mount, so if AuthContext /api/auth/me has not resolved yet the initial user is null and prefill is lost. There is no useEffect that re-hydrates the form once `user` becomes available. Feature otherwise fully behaves per spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin profile prefill lost on race — if Checkout mounts before AuthContext resolves /api/auth/me, form.name/phone/email stay empty (useState only reads user once at mount, no useEffect to sync when `user` arrives). Fields still work because they are visible and editable, but the 'prefilled from profile' UX from the bug ticket regresses.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend validation for POST /api/orders (name/phone/email) is enforced (400 with Greek messages). Frontend validation-note / inline errors / disabled-button work as designed. Only outstanding UX gap: Checkout.jsx does not resync `form` when AuthContext `user` arrives after mount — logged-in users may still see empty inputs. Regression tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_checkout_validation.py.
rca of the issue: Admin prefill race: Checkout.jsx line 28-31 uses `useState({ name: user?.name || '', phone: user?.phone || '', email: user?.email || '' })`. useState only evaluates the initializer on the first render. When user goes to /checkout right after login (or right after add-product), useAuth() may still be returning null while /api/auth/me is in flight; the form is initialized to empty strings and never re-hydrated. Fix: add `useEffect(() => { if (user) setForm(f => ({ ...f, name: f.name || user.name || '', phone: f.phone || user.phone || '', email: f.email || user.email || '' })); }, [user]);`.
